subject: Post-SF AI: inference priorities & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@shopgrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-11T16:25:00-07:00
Subject: Great to meet you at SF AI — follow-up & quick next steps

Hi Evan —

Really enjoyed our chat at the SF AI booth yesterday. Quick recap from our side: you mentioned ShopGrid is focused on reducing inference cost for real-time product tagging (low-latency, bursty traffic with seasonal spikes), and that compliance around log retention is a gating factor.

Suggested next steps:
- Quick 30-minute discovery next week to go over current architecture and expected QPS (15–30 min is fine if you want to keep it narrow)
- Rough cost sample and model/quantization options from our infra team
- If procurement is involved, happy to include them on the call to align timelines

I attached a short one-pager that summarizes how Redwood handles bursty traffic and caching. Proposed times: Tue 3/15 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 3/16 14:00–15:00 PT, or feel free to send a slot.

Attachment: SF-AI-onepager.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
https://redwood.ai
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@shopgrid.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@shopgrid.ai
Date: 2027-03-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great to meet you at SF AI — follow-up & quick next steps

Rishi —

Thanks for following up and for the one-pager. Good summary. A couple quick items from my side:
- Would like a very high-level price band (ballpark $/1k tokens or per-instance/hour) for the config you discussed — we just need to compare against our current infra spend.
- We can do Wed 3/16 14:00 PT for the discovery call — I’ll invite our infra lead (cc’ed procurement for timeline visibility).

Also: we run strict retention windows for logs (30–90 days depending on dataset), so any details on how Redwood surfaces audit logs and retention controls would be helpful beforehand.

—Evan
Evan Brooks
Head of Data Platforms, ShopGrid AI
evan.brooks@shopgrid.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@shopgrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@shopgrid.ai
Date: 2027-03-13T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great to meet you at SF AI — follow-up & quick next steps

Evan —

Perfect — I’ve locked Wed 3/16 14:00 PT on the calendar. For the high-level pricing band: below are conservative samples assuming real-time inference (g4-equivalent); we’ll tune when we learn throughput and sequence lengths on the call:

- Baseline: $0.45–0.75 per 1k generated tokens (general-purpose model variant, single-region)
- Optimized (cached prefixes + int8/quantization): $0.12–0.30 per 1k generated tokens
- Reserved capacity example (stable 24/7 throughput): starts at ~$7k/mo for a small dedicated GPU pool (typical for production endpoints)

I attached a short CSV with an illustrative cost model that you can drop into your calc. Also to your audit log question: Redwood exposes configurable retention policies (30/90/365d), streaming export to your S3, and tenant-scoped audit logs with per-token metadata. We can bring our security engineer to the call if your procurement wants deeper detail.

Attachment: prod-cost-sample.csv (csv)

If you want to prep, here are two things that help us size the right config:
- Expected 95th percentile QPS and burst size (per minute peak)
- Typical prompt + response average token length

See you Wed — invite shows up from Marissa (she’ll run the demo portion).

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick check — priority on inference work after SF AI?

Hi Evan —

Looping back since I haven’t heard after the call last week. Two quick questions so we can prioritize on our side:  
1) Has ShopGrid moved this project into a short list for Q2 procurement, or is timing still uncertain?
2) Any remaining compliance/retention docs you need from our security team before procurement will engage?

If it helps, we can do a 20-minute follow-up with our security engineer and Marissa (demo + retention Q&A) — propose Thu 3/25 09:00 PT or Fri 3/26 11:00 PT. Or, if your timeline slipped, a quick note on when you’d like us to circle back would be great.

Thanks for the time — I know post-conference inboxes get noisy.
